status: Source preparation only. No generated art, runtime edit, terrain replacement or GUI validation.

coordinate_contract.id_dispatch: negative -> FloorBig abs(id); positive -> FloorSmall id; zero -> no owner
coordinate_contract.floor_origin: cell * [48,32] + crop; ignore frame.offset; no 32-original_height top adjustment
coordinate_contract.draw_order: all floors, stable map x-major order; then objects and actors
coordinate_contract.native_raster_note: Native source diagnostic is integer world-space, NOT a pixel-exact fractional camera/GPU screenshot. View spans 768 continuous pixels; containing raster is 769 rows.

minimum_first_screen_group.definition: Exact unique source IDs for every floor rectangle intersecting initial viewport, BEFORE object occlusion. Not a proof of minimum visible-after-occlusion assets or entire A13 coverage.

material_read.evidence: Actual original RGBA mosaics and unique tile board; manual visual interpretation, not semantic tags from game.
material_read.caution: Tan road/soil texture is not wholesale silver brick. These floor images do not establish the temple object apron, object checker shadow, or building shape. Keep those contracts independent.

production_contract.phase: Future art production requires separately approved style/scale. No art generation in this task.
production_contract.strategy: Design and validate the assembled road-head region and shared grass/road edge network together, then register/cut to original owners. Do not generate 15 independent tiles with unconstrained borders.
preserve: Signed pack identities and original owner cell positions.
Actual original/crop/atlas dimensions; never resize FloorBig to the 48x32 logical grid.
Road outline, narrow stone-border continuity, grass/earth transitions and every recorded neighbor relationship.
RGBA transparency and original floor draw order; do not add checker shadow or painted building apron to floor art.
production_contract.seam_acceptance: Compare complete source and replacement mosaics at 1x and 2x and along every recorded touching edge. Edge colors need not be identical (natural texture); boundary geometry and texture continuity must be judged in combination. Test repeated -406 tiles and mixed corner/diagonal/straight road boundaries.
limits: 15 IDs cover this stationary initial floor viewport only; camera movement requires additional IDs.
Road-head small board intentionally crops the continuing southwest road; full intersecting source tiles remain supplied.
Floor 0 is no draw, not necessarily a hole; a 96x64 tile commonly covers four 48x32 logical cells.
No gameplay, object-occlusion, shader, GPU or replacement seam validation performed.
